name: The Path of the Conqueror
label: Quest
description: The Path of the Conqueror: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.
The signet ring of the conqueror will greatly enhance your physical attacks.
Be warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.
